assignments.name: topic
assignments.value: ={{ ($json.body && typeof $json.body === 'object' ? $json.body.topic : (typeof $json.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse($json.body).topic : null)) || 'How AI is changing content marketing for small businesses' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":1500,"system":"You are a sharp content strategist for a solo-founder content studio. Given a topic, propose 4-6 distinct, non-generic content angles a human editor can choose between. Respond with JSON only, no prose.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":{{ JSON.stringify('Topic: ' + $json.topic + '\n\nReturn a JSON object with a field "angles" (an array of 4-6 items, each item having headline, hook, angle_type, and target_reader) and a field "recommendation" (a string).') }}}]}

value.edited_content: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chosen_angle: $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.chosen_angle, keywords: $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.keywords }) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":2500,"system":"You are a senior content editor for Project Digital. You write outlines a human can approve in under a minute. Rules: skimmable H2/H3 hierarchy; work keywords in naturally; every section needs a one-line intent note; allocate per-section word_count values that sum to the target. Respond with JSON only, no prose, no markdown fences.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":{{ JSON.stringify('Topic: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.topic + '

Chosen angle: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.chosen_angle + '

Target word count: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.target_word_count + '

Target keywords: ' + (($('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.keywords || []).join(', ') || '(none provided)') + '

Editor notes: ' + ($('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.angle_notes || '(none)') + '

Return JSON: { "title": string, "title_alternates": [string, string], "meta_description": string (<=155 chars), "sections": [ { "heading": string, "level": "h2", "intent": string, "word_count": number, "subsections": [ { "heading": string, "level": "h3", "intent": string } ] } ], "open_questions": [string] }') }}}]}

={"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":8000,"system":"You are a writer for Project Digital. You write clear, confident, genuinely useful blog posts — no filler. Rules: follow the approved outline exactly; voice is knowledgeable peer; Markdown output with # title, ##/### for sections; work keywords in naturally; where outline flagged an open question insert a > **[EDITOR: ...]** blockquote; never fabricate statistics. Hit target word count within +/- 10%. End with a short non-salesy CTA. Output: Markdown only.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":{{ JSON.stringify('Topic: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.topic + '

Angle: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.chosen_angle + '

Keywords: ' + (($('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.keywords || []).join(', ') || '(none)') + '

Target word count: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.target_word_count + ' words.

Approved outline (JSON):
' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Outline').first().json.outline)) }}}]}

={"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":600,"system":"You are an art director for a content studio. Write a vivid, specific image-generation prompt for a 16:9 blog hero image. Editorial photography or clean illustration. No text, no logos. Include composition cues (subject, lighting, mood, palette). Return JSON only.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":{{ JSON.stringify('Topic: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.topic + '

Angle: ' + $('Parse Approval Payload').first().json.chosen_angle + '

Meta description: ' + ($('Parse Outline').first().json.outline.meta_description || '') + '

Return JSON: { "prompt": string (50-150 words), "style": string }') }}}]}

parameters.query: =SELECT cj.id, cj.topic, cj.draft_md, cj.data, COALESCE(img.image_b64, gi.image_b64) AS image_b64, COALESCE(img.mime_type, gi.mime_type, 'image/png') AS mime_type FROM content_jobs cj LEFT JOIN images img ON img.id = cj.chosen_image_id LEFT JOIN generated_images gi ON gi.job_id = cj.id AND gi.is_chosen = TRUE WHERE cj.id = '{{ $('Parse Stage4 Approval').first().json.job_id }}' LIMIT 1
